say:1:1910604001:1.text: This... energy. It's exactly the same as the nourishing essence we gathered.
say:1:1910604001:1.source_cn: 这是……能量？和我们收集的养料里的能量一模一样……

say:2:1910604002:1.text: How did this end up here? And why did they take this form?
say:2:1910604002:1.source_cn: 这些能量为什么会出现在这里，还变成了这副样子？

choice_prompt:3:1910604002.text: How did this end up here? And why did they take this form?
choice_prompt:3:1910604002.source_cn: 这些能量为什么会出现在这里，还变成了这副样子？

say:4:1910604003:1.text: Hey boss, they're blocking our way. How are we supposed to get past? Should we just take them out?
say:4:1910604003:1.source_cn: 老大，它们挡着路，咱怎么过去？直接打散？
say:4:1910604003:1.male: Hey boss, they're blocking our way. How are we supposed to get past? Should we just take them out?
say:4:1910604003:1.female: Hey boss lady, they're blocking our way. How are we supposed to get past? Should we just take them out?

say:6:1910604005:1.text: <style="highlight">The Song of Gathering and Parting</style>. The power of this song can control the group and make them scatter for a time.

say:7:1910604006:1.text: So, the Deepfolk are like us after all. They hide their power inside beautiful songs as well...
say:7:1910604006:1.source_cn: 咦，原来深海裔和我们一样，也会将力量藏在美丽的乐曲中吗？

choice_prompt:8:1910604006.text: So, the Deepfolk are like us after all. They hide their power inside beautiful songs as well...
choice_prompt:8:1910604006.source_cn: 咦，原来深海裔和我们一样，也会将力量藏在美丽的乐曲中吗？

say:10:1910604008:1.text: It's not a big deal. Keep an eye out for the musical notes scattered along the way. Pick them up if you see them.
say:10:1910604008:1.source_cn: 这不重要。留心沿路散落的音符，收集它们。

choice:8:0:1.text: Deepfolk are Merfolk after all. They just live down here.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 毕竟深海裔也是海裔，只是生活在更深处
choice:8:0:1.male: Deepfolk are Merfolk after all. They just live down here.
choice:8:0:1.female: Deepfolk are Merfolk after all. They just live down here.

choice:8:1:2.text: It's only natural that all Merfolk share some traits.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 同族之间有相似之处也很正常
choice:8:1:2.male: It's only natural that all Merfolk share some traits.
choice:8:1:2.female: It's only natural that all Merfolk share some traits.

choice:3:0:1.text: This is magic that has leaked out...
choice:3:0:1.male: This is magic that has leaked out...
choice:3:0:1.female: This is magic that has leaked out...
